backward_compatibility.guarantee: Existing consumers that ignore unknown JSON fields continue to parse canonical verdict.
backward_compatibility.versioning: No immediate gate_version bump required for additive optional fields; bump when behavior changes.
backward_compatibility.failure_behavior: If rule-pack cannot run, gate keeps canonical behavior and records rule_pack_summary.enabled=false with diagnostic reason.

path_requirements: Path must be under run-dir unless explicit policy override is approved.
Output path must be deterministic for replayability.

old_gate_ignore_unknown_fields.assumption: JSON object consumers are tolerant of unknown keys.
old_gate_ignore_unknown_fields.proposal: Keep existing top-level required fields unchanged and append rule_pack_summary/rule_packs.
old_gate_ignore_unknown_fields.migration_note: Downstream parsers expecting strict schemas should be updated to allow additive extensions.
